about: 12 drafts written from the fictional DemoClub documents in eval/sources (D01-D03 are current; D04, an outdated draft, is not given to the model). Each sentence is labelled supported or unsupported. Error types: number (a date, time, count or duration changed), outdated (taken from the superseded draft D04), invented (not in the documents), contradiction (the documents say the opposite, with no number involved). 'gold' holds the correct quotes for a supported sentence, and for an unsupported one the real sentence a careless checker would most likely cite (empty when there is none). Written on 2026-11-12; labels were fixed when the drafts were written.
